notes.title: PINNED media controller update
notes.notes:
Lazy As Studio presents another update on PINNED. After the media controller update there's four new buttons added to the UI. Users can now quickly control your media via interacting with these four buttons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40008715/62988b56ff183b3df447885d92974c722fc6dcc0.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Mute Button: Mute / Unmute
[*]Backward Button: Revert to previous media
[*]Play Button: To resume or pause the media
[*]Forward Button: Skip to next media in list
[/list]

notes.title: PINNED Overlay Update
notes.notes:
Lazy As Studio presents the biggest PINNED update that no one asked for!
A good news to all gamers who don't have two monitors.
Want to watch anime while in game?
Want to video call while in game?
Want to read a guide while in game?
We have got you covered with this PINNED Overlay Update.
It allows user to turn any window into an overlay.
A customisable hotkey has also been provided where you can toggle the overlay on and off for the ease of controlling the overlay window while in game.
If you wanna learn more about the update then check out this epic cinematic trailer on youtube:
[url=https://youtu.be/-IKnKibnGic]PINNED Overlay Update Trailer[/url]
The trailer is also coming to the store, so please stay tuned for that
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40008715/4e310a44c3081231b9318fa1326c791f2c271a72.gif[/img]

Change Details:
-Added an initial pop up screen to set up hotkey if it has not been set before
-Added a slider at the bottom of the main UI to control opacity of the Pinned window
-Toggle the hotkey to switch between the opacity that you have set and no opacity
-Changed the original wording "Exe to pin" into "Press F1 to Pin" to remind users the hotkey for pinning
-PINNED is now initialised in a state where it will not steal focus when you interact with it
-User guide has been updated to include the latest changes
